title: Pendulum Wave
prompt: A pendulum wave machine: fifteen brass bobs on fine wires from a walnut frame swing with slightly different periods, forming traveling waves and realigning exactly at the loop point.
description: Use distinct integer cycle counts to animate a bifilar pendulum wave that locks back into alignment at the seam.
